title: File:Damascus, Syria, The Umayyad Mosque, The Courtyard.jpg
author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
description: Damascus, Syria: The courtyard of the 8th-century Umayyad Mosque. The Umayyad Mosque, located in the old city of Damascus, is one of the largest and oldest mosques in the world. It is considered by some Muslims to be the fourth-holiest place in Islam.
